# templateId '*' is the GLOBAL table: rolled for EVERY mob, whatever it is. That is

# rows carry a real chance. See chance_percent() in the script, and the score column
# here, which is what those chances were derived from.

# ---- HAND-AUTHORED EXCEPTIONS ---------------------------------------------------

# produce. tools/scrape_drops.py must preserve them; if it ever overwrites one, the
# symptom is a tutorial that stops working rather than anything obviously broken.

# the only mob that has this exception."

# the item the tutorial then asks you to have, so anything under 100% is a tutorial
# that sometimes cannot be finished. It has no meso row and no second item row, and
# that is deliberate - do not add one.

# ---- THE SIX DARK MARBLE ROWS BELOW NO LONGER DECIDE ANYTHING ------------------
# They are left in place because the next scrape would put them back, and because
# they are honest about what the source said. But the marble is decided in code -
# `secondjob::marble_for_kill`, called from `session/combat.rs` - for two reasons
# these rows cannot express:
#
#   * THE MAP MATTERS. 800010 and 800015 also spawn on 80003500, and 800011 also
#     spawns on 10006160 (Precipice of Darkness), an ordinary field. A row keyed
#     on the template alone hands the second-job test's own proof to anybody
#     grinding there. Every marble is filtered OUT of the roll unless the kill
#     happened in that branch's own test field.
#   * TWO OF THE EIGHT ARE MISSING. 800014 (the Thief's Cold Eye) and 800017 (the
#     Warrior's Lupin) have no marble row at all, so half of two branches' fields
#     dropped nothing towards a test they are half of.
#
# On the right map the marble is guaranteed and deduplicated against these rows,
# so a 6% hit here cannot stack with it. `research/second-job-fields.md` section 5.3.
800010 | 4031021 | 6 | 1 | 1 | 1 | Dark Marble (Bowman)
800011 | 4031021 | 6 | 1 | 1 | 1 | Dark Marble (Bowman)
800012 | 4031019 | 6 | 1 | 1 | 1 | Dark Marble (Magician)
800013 | 4031019 | 6 | 1 | 1 | 1 | Dark Marble (Magician)
800014 | 4000034 | 40 | 1 | 1 | 1 | Cold Eye Tail
800015 | 4031023 | 6 | 1 | 1 | 1 | Dark Marble (Thief)
800016 | 4031017 | 6 | 1 | 1 | 1 | Dark Marble (Warrior)
